source.author: verg
source.text: Stetimus tela aspera contra contulimusque manus: experto credite, quantus in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam.
source.text_original: Stetimus tela aspera contra / contulimusque manus: experto credite, quantus / in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam.
source.text_english: We stood our ground against the rough weapons and matched our hands with them: believe one who has tried it, how mighty a man rises against a shield, with what whirlwind he hurls his spear.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: credite experto, quasi Christianus Christianis loquor: uenenata sunt illius dogmata, aliena a scripturis sanctis, uim scripturis facientia.
reuse.text_original: credite experto, quasi Christianus Christianis loquor: uenenata sunt illius dogmata, aliena a scripturis sanctis, uim scripturis facientia.
reuse.text_english: Believe one who has experience; as a Christian I speak to Christians: his doctrines are poisonous, alien to the Holy Scriptures, doing violence to the Scriptures.
